# Copilot Instructions

## Repository context

- Stack: Python (Home Assistant custom integration).
- Keep edits scoped, minimal, and non-invasive.

## Pull requests

- Use `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
- Keep all template sections present.
- Select exactly one checkbox under **Type of change**.
- Include validation command output in the PR body.

## Documentation gate

When changing code or configuration, update at least one of:

- `README.md`
- `docs/`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
